newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB ups '97/98 durum PRO, wheat, barley unchanged.
newsitem.headline: CWB ups '97/98 durum PRO, wheat, barley unchanged.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board said Thursday it had raised by C$5.00 per tonne its 1997/98 Pool Return Outlook (PRO) for durum and left unchanged its PROs for wheat and barley.
CWB also issued Estimated Pool Returns (EPRs) for 1996/97. These included estimates for durum wheat which were above the previous month's PROs for 1996/97.
"Based on these estimates, the CWB is recommending to the federal government that the initial payments for certain grades of durum wheat be increased," the CWB said in a news release.

CWB said the prices for durum had been stronger during the last month as dry conditions affected the North African durum crop. In general estimated returns for milling wheat remained unchanged while EPRs for feed barley were lower.
"The grain movement problems the industry is currently facing have limited the ability of the CWB to fully participate in nearby (feed barley) sales opportunities," the CWB said.
PROs are monthly CWB estimates of crop year returns, which take into account factors such as market fundamentals, weather and exchange rates.

EPRs are estimates of projected final returns for wheat and barley delivered to the CWB during the crop year. They are based on a combination of firm sales and forecasts of sales to be made between now and the end of the pooling period.
Pool returns in Canadian dollars per tonne based on grain in store St. Lawrence or Vancouver:
CWRS=Canada Western Spring Wheat. CPSR=Canada Prairie Spring Red. CPSW=Canada Prairie Spring White. CWRW= Canada Western Red Winter. CWES=Canada Western Extra Strong.
CWSWS=Canada Western Soft White Spring. CWF=Canada Western Feed. CWAD=Canada Western Amber Durum. CW=Canada Western. SS=Special Select.
